title: TIPSv2: Text-Image Pretraining with Spatial Awareness
summary: A vision-language model family by Google DeepMind that bridges the gap between image-text alignment and dense spatial understanding. It enables precise monocular depth estimation, surface normal prediction, and zero-shot semantic segmentation using patch-level alignment.
research_notes: The project includes an official feature explorer on Hugging Face Spaces and outperforms earlier self-supervised models like DINOv2 in zero-shot tasks.

evolution.summary: Following the original TIPS model, TIPSv2 introduced iBOT++ pretraining and multi-granularity synthetic captions to improve spatial awareness. It has been integrated into the Hugging Face Transformers library with specialized DPT heads for dense prediction tasks.
